Package view.album.customDialogs

Class RemoveTagDialog

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.control.Dialog<RemoveTagDialog.TagData>
view.album.customDialogs.RemoveTagDialog
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.event.EventTarget
public class RemoveTagDialog extends javafx.scene.control.Dialog<RemoveTagDialog.TagData>
A custom dialog for removing a Tag from a photo.

This dialog displays two ComboBoxes: one for selecting the tag type and another for selecting the tag value corresponding to that type. Only tag values associated with the selected type are shown.

The dialog returns a RemoveTagDialog.TagData object containing the selected type and value when the OK button is pressed. Returns null if canceled.
